div.head: Rect 5
div.ab: [5] Be ðam ðe beon bewitað. Beoceorle gebyreð, gif he gafolheorde healt, þæt he sylle ðon̄ lande geræd beo.
Bochero (id est apum custodi) pertinet, si gafolheorde (id est gregem ad censum) teneat, ut inde reddat, sicut ibi mos erit.
BE ĐAM ĐE BEON BE | witað . Beoceorle gebyreð gif he gafolheorde healt þæt he sylle ðonne lande geræd beo. mid us is geræd þæt he sylle . v . sustras huniges to gafole.
Be ðam ðe beon bewitað Beoceorle gebyreð, gif he gafolheorde healt, þæt he sylle þæt on lande geræd beo.
Von dem, der die Bienen besorgt. Dem Bienenmann, wenn er einen Schwarm auf Abgabenpflicht hält, kommt zu, dass er gebe (davon Quadr), was auf [jenem] Gute angeordnet ist.
Of him who keeps the bees. It is due from the bee-keeper, if [besides caring for the lord's hives] he keeps a swarm on terms of rent, that he give (from it, Quadr.) what is ordained on [that] estate.
Concerning those who keep bees It befits the bee-keeper, if he has a taxable swarm, that he pays as is the custom of the estate, with us [it] is custom that he pays five sesters of honey as tax.
Regarding Those Who Keep Bees It is appropriate that the beekeeper, if he possesses a swarm subject to taxation, pay whatever is assessed on that estate.
div.note: Liebermann would correct B's ‘ðoñ’ to ‘þæt on’ (or, after the Quadripartitus, ‘ðanon, swa on’ or similar).
